genome_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_genome.tsv"))

host_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_host.tsv"))

# Coassemblies list several raw data files, so hosts are resolved per assembly

  separate_rows(rawdata_id, sep = ", ") %>%
  left_join(summary_table %>% distinct(rawdata_id, host_species), by = "rawdata_id") %>%
  distinct(assembly_id, host_species)

## Taxonomic statistics

```{r genome_taxonomy_stats, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
#phylum
genome_metadata %>% 
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(genomes=n(),
            completenes=mean(completeness),
            contamination=mean(contamination),
            size=mean(genome_size)/1000000) %>%
  arrange(-genomes) %>%
  filter(phylum != "p__") %>% 
  tt()

selected_phyla <- genome_metadata %>% 
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(genomes=n(),
            completenes=mean(completeness),
            contamination=mean(contamination),
            size=mean(genome_size)/1000000) %>%
  arrange(-genomes) %>%
  filter(genomes > 0) %>% 
  filter(phylum != "p__") %>% 
  filter(phylum != "nan") %>% 
  pull(phylum)

#genus
genome_metadata %>% 
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(genomes=n(),
            completenes=mean(completeness),
            contamination=mean(contamination),
            size=mean(genome_size)/1000000) %>%
  arrange(-genomes) %>%
  filter(genus != "g__") %>% 
  tt()

#top 100 genera
genus_top100 <- genome_metadata %>% 
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(genomes=n()) %>%
  arrange(-genomes) %>%
  filter(genus != "g__") %>% 
  pull(genus) %>% 
  head(n=100)
```

## Microbial phylogenies

```{r genus_host_relationship, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
genus_host <- genome_metadata %>% 
  left_join(assembly_host,by="assembly_id") %>% 
  select(phylum,genus,host_species) %>% 
  filter(genus != "g__") %>% 
  group_by(phylum,genus,host_species) %>% 
  summarise(genomes=n()) %>% 
  arrange(-genomes) %>% 
  ungroup() 

genus_host_spread <- genus_host %>% 
    group_by(phylum,genus) %>% 
    summarise(host_species=n()) %>% 
    arrange(-host_species)

plot_genus_tree <- function(tree, metadata, palette) {
  genus_metadata <- metadata %>%
    filter(phylum %in% selected_phyla, genus %in% tree$tip.label) %>%
    count(genus, phylum, name = "count")

  tips <- tibble(genus = tree$tip.label) %>%
    left_join(genus_metadata, by = "genus")
  tip_colors <- unname(palette[tips$phylum])
  tip_colors[is.na(tip_colors)] <- "#454545"
  abundance <- log1p(replace_na(tips$count, 0))
  if (diff(range(abundance)) == 0) {
    tip_size <- rep(1, length(abundance))
  } else {
    tip_size <- 0.5 + 1.5 * (abundance - min(abundance)) / diff(range(abundance))
  }

  ape::plot.phylo(
    tree,
    type = "fan",
    show.tip.label = FALSE,
    no.margin = TRUE,
    edge.color = "#bdbdbd"
  )
  ape::tiplabels(pch = 21, bg = tip_colors, col = tip_colors, cex = tip_size)
}

```

### Annotated bacterial and archaeal genus trees

```{r genome_tree_annotated, fig.cap="Phylogenetic distribution of bacterial and archaeal genera reconstructed in EHR02. Branch and tip colours indicate phylum, while tip area scales with the number of MAGs assigned to each genus. Labels identify the 15 most abundant bacterial phyla; the side summaries report archaeal and less abundant bacterial phyla.", warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE, fig.width=13, fig.height=10, out.width="100%", dpi=300}
format_mag_count <- function(x) {
  format(x, big.mark=",", scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE)
}

genus_tree_tip_data <- function(tree, metadata) {
  genus_counts <- metadata %>%
    filter(!is.na(genus), genus != "g__", genus %in% tree$tip.label) %>%
    count(genus, phylum, name="genomes") %>%
    arrange(genus, desc(genomes)) %>%
    group_by(genus) %>%
    slice_head(n=1) %>%
    ungroup()

  tibble(genus=tree$tip.label) %>%
    left_join(genus_counts, by="genus") %>%
    mutate(
      phylum=replace_na(phylum, "Unclassified"),
      genomes=replace_na(genomes, 0L)
    )
}

genus_tree_edge_colors <- function(tree, tip_phyla, palette) {
  children <- split(tree$edge[, 2], tree$edge[, 1])
  descendant_phyla <- vector("list", Ntip(tree) + tree$Nnode)

  find_descendant_phyla <- function(node) {
    if (!is.null(descendant_phyla[[node]])) {
      return(descendant_phyla[[node]])
    }

    node_phyla <- if (node <= Ntip(tree)) {
      tip_phyla[[node]]
    } else {
      unique(unlist(
        lapply(children[[as.character(node)]], find_descendant_phyla),
        use.names=FALSE
      ))
    }
    descendant_phyla[[node]] <<- node_phyla
    node_phyla
  }

  edge_phyla <- vapply(
    tree$edge[, 2],
    function(node) {
      node_phyla <- find_descendant_phyla(node)
      if (length(node_phyla) == 1) node_phyla else NA_character_
    },
    character(1)
  )

  edge_colors <- unname(palette[edge_phyla])
  edge_colors[is.na(edge_colors)] <- "#98a2b3"
  edge_colors
}

genus_tip_cex <- function(genomes, maximum) {
  0.32 + 2.35 * sqrt(pmax(genomes, 0) / maximum)
}

spread_label_y <- function(y, lower, upper, gap) {
  if (length(y) < 2) {
    return(pmin(pmax(y, lower), upper))
  }

  order_y <- order(y)
  adjusted <- pmin(pmax(y[order_y], lower), upper)
  for (index in seq.int(2, length(adjusted))) {
    adjusted[[index]] <- max(adjusted[[index]], adjusted[[index - 1]] + gap)
  }
  if (tail(adjusted, 1) > upper) {
    adjusted <- adjusted - (tail(adjusted, 1) - upper)
  }
  for (index in seq.int(length(adjusted) - 1, 1)) {
    adjusted[[index]] <- min(adjusted[[index]], adjusted[[index + 1]] - gap)
  }
  if (adjusted[[1]] < lower) {
    adjusted <- adjusted + (lower - adjusted[[1]])
  }

  output <- numeric(length(y))
  output[order_y] <- adjusted
  output
}

draw_genus_fan <- function(
    tree,
    metadata,
    palette,
    maximum_genomes,
    x_padding=1.16,
    y_padding=1.16) {
  tree <- reorder.phylo(tree, order="cladewise")
  tip_data <- genus_tree_tip_data(tree, metadata)
  edge_colors <- genus_tree_edge_colors(tree, tip_data$phylum, palette)
  tip_colors <- unname(palette[tip_data$phylum])
  tip_colors[is.na(tip_colors)] <- "#667085"

  overlay_plot <- par("new")
  preview <- local({
    pdf(NULL)
    on.exit(dev.off(), add=TRUE)
    plot.phylo(
      tree,
      type="fan",
      show.tip.label=FALSE,
      plot=FALSE
    )
    get("last_plot.phylo", envir=.PlotPhyloEnv)
  })
  preview_radius <- max(sqrt(preview$xx^2 + preview$yy^2))
  par(new=overlay_plot)

  plot.phylo(
    tree,
    type="fan",
    show.tip.label=FALSE,
    no.margin=TRUE,
    edge.color=edge_colors,
    edge.width=0.65,
    x.lim=c(-x_padding, x_padding) * preview_radius,
    y.lim=c(-y_padding, y_padding) * preview_radius
  )
  plotted <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir=.PlotPhyloEnv)
  tip_coordinates <- tibble(
    genus=tree$tip.label,
    tree_x=plotted$xx[seq_len(Ntip(tree))],
    tree_y=plotted$yy[seq_len(Ntip(tree))]
  ) %>%
    left_join(tip_data, by="genus")

  tiplabels(
    pch=21,
    bg=adjustcolor(tip_colors, alpha.f=0.72),
    col=tip_colors,
    lwd=0.55,
    cex=genus_tip_cex(tip_data$genomes, maximum_genomes)
  )

  list(
    tree=tree,
    tips=tip_coordinates,
    radius=max(sqrt(tip_coordinates$tree_x^2 + tip_coordinates$tree_y^2))
  )
}

annotate_major_phyla <- function(tree_plot, phylum_summary, palette) {
  radius <- tree_plot$radius
  label_data <- tree_plot$tips %>%
    filter(phylum %in% phylum_summary$phylum) %>%
    mutate(angle=atan2(tree_y, tree_x)) %>%
    group_by(phylum) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_angle=atan2(mean(sin(angle)), mean(cos(angle))),
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(phylum_summary, by="phylum") %>%
    mutate(
      side=if_else(cos(mean_angle) >= 0, 1, -1),
      anchor_x=radius * cos(mean_angle),
      anchor_y=radius * sin(mean_angle),
      label_x=side * radius * 1.18,
      label_y=radius * 1.02 * sin(mean_angle),
      colour=unname(palette[phylum])
    )

  label_data$colour[is.na(label_data$colour)] <- "#667085"
  for (side_value in c(-1, 1)) {
    side_rows <- which(label_data$side == side_value)
    label_data$label_y[side_rows] <- spread_label_y(
      label_data$label_y[side_rows],
      lower=-0.91 * radius,
      upper=0.91 * radius,
      gap=0.115 * radius
    )
  }

  for (row in seq_len(nrow(label_data))) {
    label <- label_data[row, ]
    segments(
      x0=label$anchor_x,
      y0=label$anchor_y,
      x1=label$label_x - label$side * 0.025 * radius,
      y1=label$label_y,
      col=adjustcolor(label$colour, alpha.f=0.72),
      lwd=0.75
    )
    text(
      x=label$label_x,
      y=label$label_y + 0.021 * radius,
      labels=str_remove(label$phylum, "^p__"),
      adj=if (label$side == 1) c(0, 0.5) else c(1, 0.5),
      col=label$colour,
      font=2,
      cex=0.70
    )
    text(
      x=label$label_x,
      y=label$label_y - 0.025 * radius,
      labels=str_c(format_mag_count(label$genomes), " MAGs"),
      adj=if (label$side == 1) c(0, 0.5) else c(1, 0.5),
      col="#475467",
      cex=0.64
    )
  }
}

draw_phylum_summary <- function(summary_data, palette, title, columns=1) {
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim=c(0, 1), ylim=c(0, 1))
  text(0, 0.97, title, adj=c(0, 1), font=2, cex=0.94, col="#1d2939")

  rows_per_column <- ceiling(nrow(summary_data) / columns)
  for (index in seq_len(nrow(summary_data))) {
    column <- (index - 1) %/% rows_per_column
    row <- (index - 1) %% rows_per_column
    x <- column / columns + 0.025
    y <- 0.84 - row * (0.78 / max(rows_per_column - 1, 1))
    colour <- unname(palette[summary_data$phylum[[index]]])
    if (is.na(colour)) colour <- "#667085"
    points(x, y, pch=15, col=colour, cex=0.82)
    text(
      x + 0.035,
      y,
      str_c(
        str_remove(summary_data$phylum[[index]], "^p__"),
        " · ",
        format_mag_count(summary_data$genomes[[index]])
      ),
      adj=c(0, 0.5),
      cex=0.62,
      col="#344054"
    )
  }
}

draw_annotated_genus_trees <- function(
    bacteria_tree,
    archaea_tree,
    metadata,
    palette) {
  bacteria_summary <- metadata %>%
    filter(domain == "d__Bacteria", !is.na(phylum), phylum != "p__") %>%
    count(phylum, name="genomes", sort=TRUE)
  archaea_summary <- metadata %>%
    filter(domain == "d__Archaea", !is.na(phylum), phylum != "p__") %>%
    count(phylum, name="genomes", sort=TRUE)
  major_bacterial_phyla <- bacteria_summary %>% slice_head(n=15)
  additional_bacterial_phyla <- bacteria_summary %>% slice(-seq_len(15))
  maximum_genomes <- metadata %>%
    filter(!is.na(genus), genus != "g__") %>%
    count(genus) %>%
    summarise(maximum=max(n)) %>%
    pull(maximum)

  par(fig=c(0.00, 0.76, 0.00, 1.00), mar=rep(0, 4), xpd=FALSE)
  bacteria_plot <- draw_genus_fan(
    bacteria_tree,
    metadata,
    palette,
    maximum_genomes,
    x_padding=1.56,
    y_padding=1.18
  )
  annotate_major_phyla(bacteria_plot, major_bacterial_phyla, palette)
  text(
    -1.48 * bacteria_plot$radius,
    -1.10 * bacteria_plot$radius,
    "Bacteria",
    adj=c(0, 0),
    font=2,
    cex=1.28,
    col="#101828"
  )
  text(
    -1.48 * bacteria_plot$radius,
    -1.16 * bacteria_plot$radius,
    str_c(
      format_mag_count(sum(metadata$domain == "d__Bacteria")),
      " MAGs · ",
      format_mag_count(Ntip(bacteria_tree)),
      " genera"
    ),
    adj=c(0, 1),
    cex=0.78,
    col="#475467"
  )

  par(fig=c(0.73, 0.99, 0.60, 0.98), mar=rep(0, 4), new=TRUE)
  archaea_plot <- draw_genus_fan(
    archaea_tree,
    metadata,
    palette,
    maximum_genomes,
    x_padding=1.18,
    y_padding=1.18
  )
  text(
    -1.12 * archaea_plot$radius,
    1.10 * archaea_plot$radius,
    "Archaea",
    adj=c(0, 1),
    font=2,
    cex=1.22,
    col="#101828"
  )
  text(
    -1.12 * archaea_plot$radius,
    0.95 * archaea_plot$radius,
    str_c(
      format_mag_count(sum(metadata$domain == "d__Archaea")),
      " MAGs · ",
      format_mag_count(Ntip(archaea_tree)),
      " genera"
    ),
    adj=c(0, 1),
    cex=0.78,
    col="#475467"
  )

  par(fig=c(0.76, 0.99, 0.43, 0.61), mar=rep(0, 4), new=TRUE)
  draw_phylum_summary(
    archaea_summary,
    palette,
    title="Archaeal phyla",
    columns=1
  )

  par(fig=c(0.76, 0.99, 0.13, 0.43), mar=rep(0, 4), new=TRUE)
  draw_phylum_summary(
    additional_bacterial_phyla,
    palette,
    title="Additional bacterial phyla",
    columns=2
  )

  par(fig=c(0.76, 0.99, 0.01, 0.14), mar=rep(0, 4), new=TRUE)
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim=c(0, 1), ylim=c(0, 1))
  text(0, 0.92, "MAGs per genus", adj=c(0, 1), font=2, cex=0.92, col="#1d2939")
  legend_breaks <- c(25, 100, 250)
  legend_x <- c(0.08, 0.38, 0.70)
  for (index in seq_along(legend_breaks)) {
    points(
      legend_x[[index]],
      0.45,
      pch=21,
      bg="#344054",
      col="#344054",
      cex=genus_tip_cex(legend_breaks[[index]], maximum_genomes)
    )
    text(
      legend_x[[index]] + 0.075,
      0.45,
      format_mag_count(legend_breaks[[index]]),
      adj=c(0, 0.5),
      cex=0.68,
      col="#344054"
    )
  }
}

## Phylogenetically ordered genus - host heatmap

```{r genome_tree_plot, fig.cap="Host distribution of the 100 most abundant microbial genera. Genera follow the GTDB phylogenetic order; the adjacent strip identifies phylum. Circle area and colour both represent the number of recovered MAGs, and empty cells indicate combinations with no recovered MAG.", warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=16, out.width="100%", dpi=300}
genus_host_heatmap_data <- genus_host %>%
  filter(genus %in% genus_top100)

# Prune the already prepared GTDB genus trees to the genera in the heatmap.
# Bacterial and archaeal marker trees are joined below a display-only root;
# within-domain topology, rather than the artificial root branch, determines
# the vertical ordering.
heatmap_genera <- unique(genus_host_heatmap_data$genus)
heatmap_trees <- lapply(
  list(Bacteria=ehi_bacteria_tree, Archaea=ehi_archaea_tree),
  function(tree) {
    keep.tip(tree, intersect(tree$tip.label, heatmap_genera))
  }
)
heatmap_trees <- Filter(Negate(is.null), heatmap_trees)

missing_tree_genera <- setdiff(
  heatmap_genera,
  unlist(lapply(heatmap_trees, function(tree) tree$tip.label))
)
if (length(missing_tree_genera) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Displayed genera missing from the GTDB trees: ",
    str_c(missing_tree_genera, collapse=", ")
  )
}

if (length(heatmap_trees) == 1) {
  genus_tree <- heatmap_trees[[1]]
} else {
  genus_tree_newick <- vapply(
    heatmap_trees,
    function(tree) str_remove(write.tree(tree), ";$"),
    character(1)
  )
  genus_tree <- read.tree(
    text=str_c("(", str_c(genus_tree_newick, collapse=","), ");")
  )
}
genus_tree <- ladderize(genus_tree, right=FALSE)
genus_tree$edge.length <- NULL

# Use the tree's plotted y coordinates everywhere so that branches, labels,
# phylum annotation, and heatmap cells remain exactly aligned.
plot.phylo(
  genus_tree,
  type="phylogram",
  use.edge.length=FALSE,
  show.tip.label=FALSE,
  direction="rightwards",
  plot=FALSE
)
genus_tree_layout <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir=.PlotPhyloEnv)

genus_tree_nodes <- tibble(
  node=seq_along(genus_tree_layout$xx),
  tree_x=genus_tree_layout$xx,
  genus_y=genus_tree_layout$yy
)

genus_tree_segments <- as_tibble(
  genus_tree$edge,
  .name_repair="minimal"
) %>%
  set_names(c("parent", "node")) %>%
  left_join(
    genus_tree_nodes %>%
      rename(parent_x=tree_x, parent_y=genus_y),
    by=c("parent"="node")
  ) %>%
  left_join(genus_tree_nodes, by="node")

genus_tree_verticals <- genus_tree_segments %>%
  group_by(parent, parent_x) %>%
  summarise(
    genus_y_min=min(genus_y),
    genus_y_max=max(genus_y),
    .groups="drop"
  )

genus_tip_positions <- genus_tree_nodes %>%
  slice_head(n=Ntip(genus_tree)) %>%
  mutate(genus=genus_tree$tip.label) %>%
  select(genus, tree_x, genus_y) %>%
  arrange(genus_y)

tree_label_x <- max(genus_tree_nodes$tree_x) + 0.5
tree_x_limit <- tree_label_x + max(genus_tree_nodes$tree_x) * 0.75

genus_tree_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data=genus_tree_segments,
    aes(x=parent_x, xend=tree_x, y=genus_y, yend=genus_y),
    linewidth=0.35,
    colour="#667085",
    lineend="round"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data=genus_tree_verticals,
    aes(
      x=parent_x,
      xend=parent_x,
      y=genus_y_min,
      yend=genus_y_max
    ),
    linewidth=0.35,
    colour="#667085",
    lineend="round"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data=genus_tip_positions,
    aes(x=tree_x, xend=tree_label_x, y=genus_y, yend=genus_y),
    linetype="dotted",
    linewidth=0.25,
    colour="#98a2b3"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=genus_tip_positions,
    aes(
      x=tree_label_x + 0.15,
      y=genus_y,
      label=str_remove(genus, "^g__")
    ),
    size=2.7,
    fontface="italic",
    hjust=0,
    colour="#1d2939"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, tree_x_limit), expand=c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0.5, Ntip(genus_tree) + 0.5),
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip="off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin=margin(5.5, 3, 5.5, 5.5))

genus_phyla <- genus_host_heatmap_data %>%
  distinct(genus, phylum) %>%
  left_join(genus_tip_positions, by="genus")

if (anyDuplicated(genus_phyla$genus)) {
  stop("At least one displayed genus is assigned to multiple phyla.")
}

phylum_strip_plot <- genus_phyla %>%
  ggplot(aes(x="Phylum", y=genus_y, fill=phylum)) +
  geom_tile(width=0.86, height=0.86) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values=phylum_colors,
    name="Phylum",
    labels=function(x) str_remove(x, "^p__"),
    na.value="#d0d5dd"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0.5, Ntip(genus_tree) + 0.5),
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=10.5) +
  theme(
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    axis.text.y=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_text(
      angle=90,
      hjust=1,
      vjust=0.5,
      colour="#344054"
    ),
    plot.margin=margin(5.5, 1.5, 5.5, 1.5)
  )

heatmap_hosts <- host_metadata %>%
  filter(host_species %in% genus_host_heatmap_data$host_species) %>%
  distinct(host_species, host_class) %>%
  arrange(host_class, host_species)

host_levels <- heatmap_hosts$host_species
host_class_levels <- unique(heatmap_hosts$host_class)

genus_host_cells <- expand_grid(
  genus=genus_tip_positions$genus,
  host_species=host_levels
) %>%
  left_join(genus_tip_positions, by="genus") %>%
  left_join(heatmap_hosts, by="host_species") %>%
  left_join(
    genus_host_heatmap_data %>% select(genus, host_species, genomes),
    by=c("genus", "host_species")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genomes=replace_na(genomes, 0L),
    host_species=factor(host_species, levels=host_levels),
    host_class=factor(host_class, levels=host_class_levels)
  )

genus_host_dot_heatmap <- ggplot(
  genus_host_cells,
  aes(x=host_species, y=genus_y)
) +
  facet_nested(. ~ host_class, space="free_x", scales="free_x") +
  geom_tile(
    width=0.92,
    height=0.86,
    fill="#f2f4f7",
    colour="white",
    linewidth=0.25
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=filter(genus_host_cells, genomes > 0),
    aes(size=genomes, fill=genomes),
    shape=21,
    stroke=0.2,
    colour="white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours=c("#cdebf1", "#61b6c9", "#167d9a", "#073b66"),
    trans="sqrt",
    name="Recovered MAGs"
  ) +
  scale_size_area(max_size=5.2, guide="none") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0.5, Ntip(genus_tree) + 0.5),
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=10.5) +
  theme(
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    axis.text.y=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_text(
      size=9.5,
      angle=55,
      hjust=1,
      vjust=1,
      face="italic",
      colour="#344054"
    ),
    strip.background=element_rect(fill="#e4e9ef", colour="white"),
    strip.text=element_text(size=9.5, face="bold", colour="#344054"),
    panel.spacing.x=unit(1.5, "mm"),
    plot.margin=margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 1.5),
    legend.position="right"
  )

genus_host_heatmap <- wrap_plots(
  genus_tree_plot,
  phylum_strip_plot,
  genus_host_dot_heatmap,
  nrow=1,
  widths=c(3.5, 0.35, 8),
  guides="collect"
)

ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_genus_host_heatmap.svg")),
  plot=genus_host_heatmap,
  width=16,
  height=16,
  units="in",
  bg="white"
)
ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_genus_host_heatmap.pdf")),
  plot=genus_host_heatmap,
  width=16,
  height=16,
  units="in",
  bg="white"
)
ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_genus_host_heatmap.png")),
  plot=genus_host_heatmap,
  width=16,
  height=16,
  units="in",
  dpi=300,
  bg="white"
)

genus_host_heatmap
